# Mudbriar — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

Mudbriar is Maud Pie’s devoted, stick-loving boyfriend: a very literal Earth-pony stallion whose soft, measured voice and constant “technically” corrections drive Pinkie Pie up the wall. He studies twigs with the same seriousness that Maud gives rocks, and even has a pet stick named Twiggy.

[![Mudbriar speaking with Maud Pie in The Maud Couple](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2021/2/18/2302902__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_maud%2Bpie_mudbriar_earth%2Bpony_pony_the%2Bmaud%2Bcouple_female_male_mare_stallion.png)](https://twibooru.org/2302902)

*Show still:* Mudbriar and Maud in “The Maud Couple” (S8E3); animation from the Hasbro/DHX television series.

**Appearance:** Tall and slim, with a yellowish-gray coat, angular light-brown bowl-cut mane, small tied-back tail, green eyes, and a twig-shaped cutie mark with green leaves. His permanently analytical expression is a giveaway.

**Name and voice:** Maud introduces him aloud as *Mudbriar* in his 2018 debut, “The Maud Couple”—a show-established name, not a retrospective fan nickname. Some fan posts write *Mud Briar* instead. “Stick pony” is his own description, not an alter ego. He has substantial spoken dialogue, voiced in English by **Adam Kirschner**, as recorded in the [season-eight voice credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_eight).

**Appearances:** Beyond his S8E3 debut, he has a Hearts and Hooves Day date with Maud in “The Break Up Break Down” (S8E10); appears in *Best Gift Ever*, “Student Counsel” (S9E11), “A Trivial Pursuit” (S9E16), and the final episodes, including “The Last Problem” (S9E26). He also has minor animated-short and IDW comic appearances; see the [character appearance record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Mudbriar).

## Important moments

1. **Pinkie meets Maud’s boyfriend** — *The Maud Couple* (S8E3). Maud introduces Mudbriar after Pinkie has already been irritated by his obsessive distinction between “goodbye” and “see you later”; their petrified-wood debate establishes why Maud adores him. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rSKGw9FymVI) (scene timestamp unavailable).
2. **A birthday party Maud actually enjoys** — *The Maud Couple* (S8E3). After Pinkie apologizes, Mudbriar proposes a party the guests can enjoy while Maud celebrates quietly nearby with the ponies she loves. [Episode dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Maud_Couple) (scene timestamp unavailable).
3. **The cockatrice rescue** — *Student Counsel* (S9E11). Mudbriar joins the search for missing Silverstream, is turned to stone, and, after Edith reverses it, finds a newfound appreciation for rocks. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oNv4jfY-xcA) (scene timestamp unavailable).
4. **A technically correct trivia answer** — *A Trivial Pursuit* (S9E16). Mudbriar insists that **both Tirek and Scorpan** traveled to Equestria, correcting Twilight’s incomplete answer and winning the point. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=40btN22uf1A) (scene timestamp unavailable).
